verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own marketing says you can ask Copilot to "open a new pull request" in natural language, and that issues assigned to Copilot come back as ready-to-review pull requests that can be iterated on and merged within the app. That means PR creation on device is documented only through the Copilot agent, not as a direct user-authored flow. A community note calls the app "not really a git client", which signals limits but does not concretely contradict the claim. Missing for 10: documented manual PR creation (choosing head and base branches, title and description) in the app, support beyond GitHub itself, and hands-on corroboration of creating a PR from mobile.
